text:
Mira: LAN night tonight 7pm in the 3rd-floor lounge. Quick q — who's bringing power strips/extension cords? I want to set up a RetroPie HDMI station and might need an HDMI->USB-C for the dock. Office has one surge strip so extras would help.
Joel: I can bring a 6ft surge strip and a 2-port USB charger. I'll label mine 'LAN-JOEL' with tape. :thumbsup:
Sam: I have an HDMI switch (3-in 1-out) if we want quick switching between consoles. Also bringing Mario Kart for chaos. :joystick:
Olivia: @Mira I can bring an HDMI->USB-C adapter (for Switch dock) and a small extension cord. Do we have any rules about plugging into the AV cabinet? @ops-bot?
ops-bot: Reminder: floor power is available but avoid running cords across walkways. Please follow office safety guidelines: https://intranet/office/safety/power-cords
Ryan: I'll bring snacks (pretzels) and an extra ethernet cable (10m). RSVP: react with :raised_hands: if youre coming.
Mira: Sweet. Tentative list: Joel, Sam, Olivia, Ryan, Mira. If youre coming pls react :raised_hands:. Also please mark your strips with your name so we don't accidentally take each other's chargers. We'll do a 2-players-per-table rule for tournament rounds to keep lines moving.
Joel: Got it. Tape + sharpie ready.
Sam: Also FYI: my Pi image for RetroPie needs GamePad X mapping patched. If anyone has an 8BitDo, please bring it.
Olivia: :sweat_smile: I have one 8BitDo. I'll bring it but no promises on my bracket performance.
Mira: If anyone can bring a small power strip with socket covers (surge protect preferred) thatd be ideal. See you at 7! :party_parrot:
